raised_by: founder, mid-run, after inspecting the first real Northern Ireland extraction result
problem_observed: The initial bulk-OSM pipeline discovered raw candidates using ingestion/uk-national-discovery/overpass-bbox-query.mjs's existing TAG_CLAUSES unchanged (as package-01/02 already did for its live Overpass sweep), which deliberately includes bare amenity=community_centre as a broad discovery net. At NATIONAL BULK scale this produced 900 raw Northern-Ireland-boundary-filtered elements of which the overwhelming majority (844) were generic village/church/community halls with no live-event evidence -- not live-event venues. A generic physical place that COULD host an event is not automatically a BeatMapped live-event venue candidate.
fix_applied: Added a new pre-candidacy eligibility gate (ingestion/uk-national-bulk-osm/candidate-eligibility.mjs), run BETWEEN raw extraction and VenueDiscoveryCandidate construction. An element only enters the main candidate census if it clears one of two governed bars, both reusing EXISTING, already-governed logic (no new/invented criteria): (1) DIRECT_TAG_SIGNAL -- the element's own tags satisfy admission.mjs's own AUTO_ADMIT_ELIGIBLE_SIGNALS (amenity=nightclub/theatre/arts_centre, live_music=yes, music_venue=yes, or pub/bar WITH live_music=yes); or (2) EXISTING_REGISTRY_STRONG_MATCH -- existing-registry.mjs's own matchGroup() finds a STRONG (not merely possible) match against an already-known active source or canonical venue. Every filtered-out element's full OSM identity, tags, and coordinates are retained (never discarded) as a FILTERED_GENERIC_NON_EVENT_LEAD, reported separately, and never counted among candidates/review/insufficient-evidence.

sample_relevant_candidates: Market Place Theatre and Arts Centre

scope_of_fix: Applies to both already-extracted NI data (reclassified above) and the in-progress Great Britain extraction, whose raw output (broad TAG_CLAUSES net, full tags preserved) is a strict superset safely reclassified by this SAME eligibility gate once loaded -- no need to discard or restart GB's already-substantial extraction work, since nothing about the raw extraction step itself was incorrect, only what was allowed to become a CANDIDATE from that raw data.
tag_clauses_unchanged: ingestion/uk-national-discovery/overpass-bbox-query.mjs's TAG_CLAUSES/EXPLICIT_RELEVANCE_CLAUSES (the shared, package-01/02-governed DISCOVERY net) were NOT modified -- they still determine what gets pulled out of the raw PBF stream at all, exactly as package-02's live Overpass sweep already did. The fix is a NEW, additional gate at the candidate-construction boundary, not a change to the existing governed query/discovery semantics.
